recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composite of four male faces emerging from a black void, each treated with a distinct surreal texture: red/yellow harlequin diamonds, blue sky with white clouds, and green electronic circuit board traces. The typography is ultra-condensed and spans the top edge, adopting the textures of the faces below.
coreVisualRelationships: Texture-to-subject mapping where skin is replaced by patterns
Extreme chiaroscuro lighting against a pure black background
Vertical alignment between the textured faces and the corresponding letters above
Juxtaposition of organic human features with geometric and technological motifs
coreInvariants: Diamond harlequin pattern in red and yellow
Green circuit board traces with visible solder points
Cyan blue sky with soft white cumulus clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four faces arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, varying in tilt and crop, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue-cloud face with hands raised in a prayer-like gesture.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the bold, textured title at the top, down through the four distinct vertical columns of textured faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background isolates the subjects and provides high contrast for the vibrant patterns.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Primary Red, Yellow, Cyan, and Green (textures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the patterns contrasted against zero-value black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are masked with the same textures as the faces below (harlequin, clouds, circuits)
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, wide geometric sans-serif for secondary metadata to contrast the verticality of the main title.

preserve: Texture continuity between text and image

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality
Clean grotesque structure suitable for masking

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a composite of four male faces against a black background. Apply a red/yellow diamond harlequin pattern to the far left and far right faces. Apply a cyan sky with white clouds to the second face. Apply a green circuit board pattern to the third face. Use high-contrast lighting so shadows are pure black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place ultra-condensed bold sans-serif text across the top. Mask the first few letters with the harlequin pattern, the middle letters with the cloud pattern, and the final letters with the circuit pattern to match the faces below.

verificationChecks: Textures in text align vertically with textures on faces

mustRedesign: Japanese characters in the red box

mustAchieve: Seamless texture mapping onto facial contours

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the harlequin pattern follows the curve of the face
Check that the circuit board lines are crisp
Verify the text is legible despite the heavy patterns
Confirm no text exists outside the top header and small metadata
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Subject: Faces] with [Texture A: Harlequin], [Texture B: Clouds], and [Texture C: Circuits] against [Background: Black] using [Typography: Ultra-Condensed Sans-Serif] masked with identical textures.
